<form create="0" delete="0">
                <sheet>
                    <group>
                        <field name="program_id" readonly="1" on_change="1"/>
                        <field name="cycle_mnemonic" readonly="is_readonly"/>
                        <field name="target_registry" invisible="1"/>
                        <field name="approved_for_disbursement" invisible="1"/>
                        <field name="is_readonly" invisible="1"/>
                    </group>

                    <!-- Hide fields during creation -->
                    <notebook>
                        <!-- Priority Rules -->
                        <page string="Disbursement Rules" invisible="id == False">
                            <field name="priority_rule_ids" readonly="approved_for_disbursement" nolabel="1" options="{'no_quick_create': True}" context="{'default_target_registry': target_registry}"><tree string="Disbursement Rule">
                <control>
                    <create string="Add Disbursement Rule"/>
                </control>
                <field name="mnemonic"/>
                <field name="description"/>
                <field name="target_registry" invisible="0"/>
                <button name="action_open_view" type="object" string="View Disbursement Rule" class="oe_link" title="View Disbursement Rule"/>
            </tree></field>
                        </page>
                        <!-- Disbursement List -->
                        <page string="Disbursement List" invisible="id == False">
                            <field name="beneficiary_list_ids" nolabel="1" readonly="approved_for_disbursement">
                                <tree default_order="creation_date desc" delete="false" limit="10">
                                    <control>
                                        <create string="Create New Disbursement List"/>
                                    </control>
                                    <field name="mnemonic" string="Mnemonic"/>
                                    <field name="eligibility_process_status" string="Priority Process Status" widget="badge"/>
                                    <field name="entitlement_process_status" string=" Entitlement Summary Status" widget="badge"/>
                                    <field name="creation_date" string="Created On" readonly="1"/>
                                    <field name="processed_date" string="Processed On" readonly="1"/>
                                    <field name="list_workflow_status" string="Status" widget="badge" invisible="list_workflow_status != 'approved_for_disbursement'"/>
                                    <button name="action_open_summary_wizard" type="object" string="View Disbursement List" class="oe_link" invisible="entitlement_process_status!='complete'"/>
                                </tree>
                            </field>
                        </page>
                    </notebook>
                </sheet>
            </form>

<form create="0" delete="0">
                <sheet>
                    <group colspan="2">
                        <group string="Enrollment Cycle">
                            <field name="is_readonly" invisible="1"/>
                            <field name="cycle_number" readonly="1" on_change="1"/>
                            <field name="program_id" readonly="1"/>
                            <field name="approved_for_enrollment" invisible="1"/>
                        </group>
                        <group string="Cycle Configuration">
                            <field name="enrollment_start_date" readonly="is_readonly"/>
                            <field name="enrollment_end_date" readonly="is_readonly"/>
                            <field name="disbursement_start_date" readonly="is_readonly" nolabel="0"/>
                            <field name="disbursement_end_date" readonly="is_readonly" nolabel="0"/>
                        </group>
                    </group>
                    <notebook>
                        <page string="Enrollment Lists" invisible="id == False">
                            <field name="beneficiary_list_ids" nolabel="1" readonly="approved_for_enrollment">
                                <tree default_order="creation_date desc" delete="false" limit="10">
                                    <control>
                                        <create string="Create New Enrollment List"/>
                                    </control>
                                    <field name="mnemonic" string="Mnemonic"/>
                                    <field name="eligibility_process_status" string="Eligibility Process Status" widget="badge"/>
                                    <field name="creation_date" string="Created On" readonly="1"/>
                                    <field name="processed_date" string="Processed On" readonly="1"/>
                                    <field name="list_workflow_status" string="Status" widget="badge" invisible="list_workflow_status == 'initiated'"/>                  
                                    <button name="action_open_summary_wizard" type="object" string="View Enrollment List" class="oe_link" invisible="eligibility_process_status!='complete'"/>
                                </tree>
                            </field>
                        </page>
                    </notebook>
                </sheet>
            </form>

<form string="Disbursement Rule">
                <sheet>
                    <group>
                        <field name="mnemonic"/>
                        <field name="description"/>
                        <field name="target_registry" invisible="0" on_change="1"/>

                <!-- Domain widget for the 'farmer' type -->
                <field name="pbms_domain" widget="domain" options="{'model': 'g2p.farmer.registry', 'allowed_fields': ['priority_rank']}" invisible="target_registry != 'farmer'" on_change="1"/>

                <!-- Domain widget for the 'student' type -->
                <field name="pbms_domain" widget="domain" options="{'model': 'g2p.student.registry', 'allowed_fields': ['priority_rank']}" invisible="target_registry != 'student'" on_change="1"/>
                    </group>
                </sheet>
                <sheet>
                    <group>
                        <field name="sql_query"/>
                    </group>
                </sheet>
            </form>

service_providers_required.help: If checked, the program will require benefits to be collected from specified agency and warehouse. If unchecked, beneficiaries may collect benefits from any agency/warehouse in the country.

verifications_for_enrolment.help: Minimum number of verifications required before lists can be approved

auto_approve_enrolment.help: If enabled and the number of required verifications is 0, lists will be automatically approved as soon as they are created, without needing any verifications.

verifications_for_disbursement.help: Minimum number of verifications required before lists can be approved

auto_approve_disbursement.help: If enabled and the number of required verifications is 0, lists will be automatically approved as soon as they are created, without needing any verifications.

view.arch:
<form string="G2P Programs">
        <sheet>
          <group>
            <group string="Program Information">
              <field name="id" invisible="1"/>
              <field name="program_mnemonic" readonly="not context.get('program_form_edit')"/>
              <field name="description" readonly="not context.get('program_form_edit')"/>
              <field name="program_status" readonly="not context.get('program_form_edit')"/>
            </group>
            <group string="Program Configuration">
              <field string="Base Registry" name="target_registry" readonly="not context.get('program_form_create')"/>
              <field name="service_providers_required" readonly="not context.get('program_form_create')"/>
              <field name="show_label_for_beneficiary_list" invisible="1"/>
            </group>
            <group string="Enrollment Configuration">
              <field string="Frequency" name="enrollment_frequency" readonly="not context.get('program_form_edit')"/>
              <field string="# of Verifications" name="verifications_for_enrolment" readonly="not context.get('program_form_edit')"/>
              <field name="auto_approve_enrolment" readonly="not context.get('program_form_edit')"/>
            </group>
            <group string="Disbursement Configuration">
              <field string="Frequency" name="disbursement_frequency" readonly="not context.get('program_form_edit')"/>
              <field string="# of Verifications" name="verifications_for_disbursement" readonly="not context.get('program_form_edit')"/>
              <field name="auto_approve_disbursement" readonly="not context.get('program_form_edit')"/>
            </group>
          </group>
          <notebook>
            <!-- Benefit Codes Page (Invisible) -->
            <page string="Benefit Codes" invisible="1">
              <field name="benefit_code_ids" nolabel="1" options="{'no_quick_create': True}"><tree string="Benefit Codes">
                <field name="benefit_mnemonic"/>
                <field name="benefit_type"/>
                <field name="measurement_unit"/>
                <field name="benefit_description"/>
                <button name="action_open_edit" type="object" class="fa fa-pencil"/>
            </tree></field>
            </page>
            <!-- Program Benefit Codes Page -->
            <page string="Program Benefit Codes">
              <field name="program_benefit_code_ids" nolabel="1" options="{'no_quick_create': True}" on_change="1"><tree string="Program Program Benefit Codes">
            <control>
                <create string="Add Program Benefit Code"/>
            </control>
                <field name="benefit_mnemonic"/>
                <field name="benefit_type"/>
                <field name="max_quantity"/>
                <field name="measurement_unit"/>
                <field name="benefit_description"/>
            </tree></field>
            </page>
            <!-- Eligibility Rules Page -->
            <page string="Eligibility Rules">
              <field name="eligibility_rule_ids" nolabel="1" options="{'no_quick_create': True}" context="{'default_program_id': id, 'default_target_registry': target_registry}"><tree string="Eligibility Rule" default_order="rule_number asc">
                <control>
                  <create string="Add Eligibility Rule"/>
                </control>
                <field name="rule_number"/>
                <field name="mnemonic"/>
                <field name="target_registry"/>
                <field name="set_operator"/>
                <field name="description"/>
                <button name="action_open_view" type="object" string="View Eligibility Rule" class="oe_link" title="View Eligibility Rule"/>
            </tree></field>
            </page>
            <!-- Entitlement Rules Page -->
            <page string="Entitlement Rules">
              <field name="entitlement_rule_ids" nolabel="1" options="{'no_quick_create': True}" context="{'default_target_registry': target_registry, 'default_allowed_benefit_code_ids': benefit_code_ids}"><tree string="Entitlement Rule">
                <control>
                    <create string="Add Entitlement Rule"/>
                  </control>
                <field name="mnemonic" string="Rule Mnemonic" options="{'no_create': True, 'no_edit': True}"/>
                <field name="benefit_code_id" string="Benefit Code" on_change="1"/>
                <field name="target_registry"/>
                <field name="quantity" string="Quantity"/>
                <field name="measurement_unit" string="Measurement Unit"/>
                <field name="multiplier" string="Multiplier"/>
                <field name="description" string="Description"/>
                <button name="action_open_view" type="object" string="View Entitlement Rule" class="oe_link" title="View Entitlement Rule"/>
            </tree></field>
            </page>
            <!-- Enrollment Cycles Page -->
            <page string="Enrollment Cycles">
              <field name="enrollment_cycle_ids" no_label="0" context="{'default_program_id': id}" mode="tree"><tree default_order="cycle_number desc" delete="false">
                <control>
                    <create string="Create New Enrollment Cycle"/>
                </control>
                <field name="cycle_number" string="Cycle Number" on_change="1"/>
                <field name="enrollment_start_date" string="Enrollment Start Date"/>
                <field name="enrollment_end_date" string="Enrollment End Date"/>
                <field name="disbursement_start_date" string="Disbursement Start Date"/>
                <field name="disbursement_end_date" string="Disbursement End Date"/>
                <field name="approved_for_enrollment" string="Approved for Enrollment"/>
                <button name="action_open_view" type="object" string="View Enrollment Cycle" class="oe_link"/>
            </tree></field>
            </page>
            <!-- Disbursement Cycles Page -->
            <page string="Disbursement Cycles">
              <field name="disbursement_cycle_ids" nolabel="1"><tree default_order="creation_date desc" delete="false">
                <control>
                    <create string="Create New Disbursement Cycle"/>
                </control>
                <field name="cycle_mnemonic" string="Cycle"/>
                <!-- <field name="bridge_envelope_id" readonly="1"/> -->
                <field name="approved_for_disbursement" widget="boolean_button" readonly="1"/>
                <!-- <field name="envelope_creation_status" string="Envelope Creation Status" widget="badge"/> -->
                <!-- <field name="batch_creation_status" string="Disbursement Batch Creation Status" widget="badge"/> -->
                <field name="creation_date" string="Created On"/>
                <button name="action_open_view" type="object" string="View Disbursement Cycle" class="oe_link"/>
                <!-- <button name="action_open_disbursement_envelope_summary_wizard" type="object" string="View Envelope Summary" class="oe_link" invisible="envelope_creation_status != 'complete'"/> -->
            </tree></field>                
            </page>
          </notebook>
        </sheet>
      </form>

<form string="Eligibility Rule">
                <sheet>
                    <group>
                        <field name="rule_number" readonly="rule_number==1"/>
                        <field name="mnemonic"/>
                        <field name="description"/>
                        <field name="target_registry" on_change="1"/>
                        <field name="set_operator" readonly="rule_number==1"/>

                <!-- Domain widget for the 'farmer' type -->
                <field name="pbms_domain" widget="domain" options="{'model': 'g2p.farmer.registry'}" invisible="target_registry != 'farmer'" on_change="1"/>

                <!-- Domain widget for the 'student' type -->
                <field name="pbms_domain" widget="domain" options="{'model': 'g2p.student.registry'}" invisible="target_registry != 'student'" on_change="1"/>
                    </group>
                </sheet>
                <sheet>
                    <group>
                        <field name="sql_query"/>
                    </group>
                </sheet>
            </form>

<form string="Entitlement Rule">
                <sheet>
                    <group>
                        <field name="allowed_benefit_code_ids" invisible="1"/>
                        <field name="allowed_multipliers" invisible="1"/>
                        <field name="mnemonic"/>
                        <field name="description"/>
                        <field name="target_registry" invisible="0" on_change="1"/>

                        <field name="quantity"/>
                        <field name="multiplier" widget="g2p_pbms.multiplier_widget"/>
